note: Adapted from Holmgren's (1913) original species-level description, originally in German; it covers the imago, the soldier and the large and small worker types, with measurements in mm, and some figures are damaged in the scan, so only the legible values are entered. The original printed the name as Microcerotermes suluensis through an s/z misprint; the BSF name zuluensis is used here. Type localities in Zululand: Entendweni, Mkosi, Somkele, Mtewa. The author notes that the soldier head length varies greatly within a nest and on that basis established the four forms laticeps, grandis, hamatus and rubriceps.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Very similar to M. parvus but much paler. Head brown, clypeus almost yellow; dorsal sclerites of the body and the legs (except the tarsi) brown to light brown; sternites pale yellow, paler in the middle; tarsi pale yellow. Head shape as in parvus, but the compound eyes smaller and less prominent; ocelli small, separated from the compound eye by more than their diameter. Pronotum small, the posterior margin slightly concave. Wings narrow, far narrower than in parvus; media with 2—3 apical branches, cubitus with 5—6 branches. Measurements: body length with wings 7 mm, body length without wings 5 mm, forewing length (5.5—) 6 mm, width 1.57 mm, head length 1.03 mm, pronotum width 0.64 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, turning very faintly brown anteriorly; body almost white, the gut contents showing through the abdomen. Head with short fine hairs, the abdominal tergites with fine short hairs. Head rectangular, distinctly longer than wide, rather thick, the front deflexed and slightly raised. Labrum covering the inner third of the mandibles, slightly pentagonal with rounded corners; mandibles rather short and stout, irregularly finely serrate, their outer base bent inwards at almost a right angle and the rest evenly curved, so that the front of the head looks truncate. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 mostly shorter than segment 4 and always narrower. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin very weakly concave in the middle. Measurements: body length 4—5.5 mm, head length including the mandibles 1.56—2.09 mm, head width 0.65—0.85 mm, pronotum width about 0.57 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head pale yellow, body white with the gut contents showing through. Head with short fine hairs, the abdominal tergites with fine short hairs. Head rather elongate, rectangular with rounded corners, rather thick; postclypeus about half as long as wide, the posterior margin strongly convex, the anterior margin straight. Mouthparts short; antennae mostly 12-segmented, or 13-segmented through a transverse division of segment 3; in the 12-segmented antenna segment 3 is about equal in length to segment 2 and segment 4 shorter than segment 3; in the 13-segmented antenna segment 3 is very short. Anterior margin of the pronotum imperceptibly concave. Measurements: body length 3.5—4.5 mm, head width 0.76—0.87 mm, pronotum width 0.5—0.53 mm. The small worker has the same colour and pilosity as the large worker, with a rounder and shorter head and 12—13-segmented antennae.
